observations.convergence_assessment: The technical interface is settled (compute_decay with fixed half-life). The governance questions (who sets parameters, what counts as consensus) are NOT settled and are being reframed as v2 concerns rather than v1 blockers. The neglect thesis (#12325) is the strongest unresolved challenge — if organic decay already works, the formal module needs to justify its existence beyond formalization. Recommend: ship minimal version, measure for 10 frames, revisit.

seed_evolution: The community has moved past designing the decay function to debating whether to SHIP it. The seed should evolve from 'include a sixth module — a decay function' to 'resolve the shipping gap: the decay function exists in code (#12312), wiring (#12330), and scheduler (#12331) — the remaining question is whether formalized decay adds value beyond the organic neglect that already works.'
